handoutPs: You are paid $38,000 a year. You keep about $84,400 a year. More pay does not add to that until you are paid $45,000 a year: a raise of $7,000 a year. It happens again between $45,000 and $119,000.
$29,379 of what you keep is child care help paid straight to your day care.
The biggest drop is at $55,000 of pay: child care help ends and you keep $25,449 less. Food help ends at $54,000.
Your kids' health plan ends at $73,000 of pay — but not that year. It ends at their next yearly check, up to 12 months later.
These are estimates. A case worker decides real help.
Printed from HotGap. 2026 rules. Sweep of 2026-09-16.
